# Hospital Operations Dashboard

## Overview
This dashboard provides a real-time view of hospital operations, tracking bed occupancy, patient admissions, discharge flow, and departmental census. It supports clinical leadership in managing capacity, reducing wait times, and improving patient throughput.

## Key Metrics
- Patient Census: 312
- Bed Occupancy Rate: 87.5%
- ER Average Wait Time: 34 minutes

## Insights
- ICU and surgical wards are near capacity — proactive discharge planning is recommended.
- ER wait times have increased by 12% over the past two weeks, correlating with higher admissions volume.
- 30-day readmission rate of 8.1% is within acceptable range but trending upward for cardiac patients.
